_metadata.description: TATRA T 815-7N0R99 8x8.1R high-mobility heavy-duty cargo/troop carrier with crane. Central backbone tube with independently swinging half-axles and air springs on all four axles, two steered front axles, wheel hub reductions. Axle spacings, overall dimensions, weights, tyres, powertrain and performance are published; geometry details and rates are estimates.
_metadata.author: RFloEng

data_origin.detail: Published (Tatra data sheet): axle spacings 1950/3250/1450 mm, front overhang 1605 mm, rear overhang to crane/hitch 1200 + 278 mm, overall length 9750 ± 30 mm, width 2500 mm, track 2072 mm, clearance 410 mm (adjustable), heights, approach/ramp/departure angles, curb weight, payload, GVW, tyres and rims, suspension and axle concept, engine, transmission, transfer box, performance. Estimated (_est): hardpoints, CG, spring/damper/anti-roll rates, twin-steer ratio, transfer and axle ratios, tyre overall diameter.
